caption: Figure 1: The lifecycle of an FL-trained model and the various actors in a federated learning system. This figure is revisited in Section 4 from a threat models perspective.
description:
Figure type: Diagram showing the lifecycle of a federated learning model.
Description: The diagram illustrates the lifecycle of a federated learning (FL) model, highlighting the various stages and actors involved. It starts with clients, moves to federated learning, then to a server, and finally to model testing, deployment, and use by the rest of the world. Key actors include clients, admin, engineers, and analysts.

Text in figure: clients, federated learning, server, model testing, engineers & analysts, model deployment, rest of the world, admin.

caption: Figure 2: Split learning configurations showing raw data is not transferred in the vanilla setting and that raw data as well as labels are not transferred between the client and server entities in the U-shaped split learning setting.
description:
This figure is a diagram comparing two split learning configurations: vanilla and U-shaped. It shows how data and labels are distributed between clients and servers. In vanilla split learning, only input data is transferred to the server, while labels remain with the client. In U-shaped split learning, both input data and labels are not transferred between client and server.

Text in figure: Vanilla split learning, U-shaped split learning, Input Data, Labels, Client, Server.

caption: Figure 1: The lifecycle of an FL-trained model and the various actors in a federated learning system. (repeated from Page 7)
description:
Figure type: Diagram showing the lifecycle of a federated learning (FL) model and the roles of different actors in the system.

Description: The diagram illustrates the lifecycle of an FL-trained model, starting with data collection from clients, followed by federated learning, model testing, and finally model deployment. It also shows the roles of various actors, including clients, engineers, analysts, and the rest of the world.

Text in figure: clients, federated learning, server, model testing, engineers & analysts, model deployment, rest of the world, admin.

caption: Figure 3: The Encode-Shuffle-Analyze (ESA) framework, illustrated here for 4 players.
description:
Figure type: Diagram
Description: The diagram illustrates the Encode-Shuffle-Analyze (ESA) framework for federated learning with four participants: Alice, Bob, Clarice, and David. Each participant encodes their data using a local randomizer, shuffles the encoded data, and then analyzes it. The shuffler component is central, receiving shuffled data from all participants.

Text in figure: Alice, Bob, Clarice, David, Local Randomizer, Shuffler, Analyzer, X1, X2, X3, X4, V1.1, V1.2, V1.3, V2.1, V2.2, V2.3, V3.1, V3.2, V3.3, V4.1, V4.2, V4.3
